reasoning_content:
Resources: 951G of disk, 7.6G of RAM, 8 CPUs. Should be enough.

Alright, let's run `make run` in the background and record the logs. Since this will build the image (poetry install + downloading the paddleocr model), it could take 10-30 minutes.

action.command: cd /workspace && nohup make run > /workspace/make_run.log 2>&1 & echo "started PID $!"
